The API boundary is a deterministic in-memory adapter; production network transport, server behavior, durable persistence, authentication, and authorization are outside scope.
The optional responsive viewport dimension and reload/cross-session persistence are explicitly excluded from this declared replication scope.
The detailed runtime archive is a GitHub Actions artifact with a 30-day retention period; the committed harness regenerates it.

replicationScope.description: Task Board browser application at 1280×800 CSS px, including all declared rendered UI properties and states, create/complete/filter/delete workflows, keyboard operation, native input validation, API success/failure outcomes, and the deterministic in-memory API boundary. Responsive variants, durable persistence, production transport, authentication, and authorization are explicitly excluded. The capture also includes partial business-rule and data observations for task creation, summary counts, and task record exchanges; these facets are not complete.
